text:
maria.gomez: FYI — we're opening two Dedicated micro-pools tomorrow 2026-04-02 05:00 UTC: us-midwest-1 (CHI) and asia-southeast-3 (MNL). These are small, latency-optimised pools for low-batch inference and bursty PLG traffic. Pools use the new nv-a100z (A100z-32GB-quant) profile. :rocket:

kyle-ops: Quick q — is this reserved capacity or burst-only? Any impact to existing Dedicated customers?

maria.gomez: It's a mix: primary target is Dedicated reservations (monthly/annual), but we'll allow controlled burst for existing Dedicated tenants during the pilot. No evictions of committed reservations. Burst policy: max 20% of pool for non-reserved in pilot week.

samir.patel: Can you share rough capacity numbers per region? Need to update capacity dashboard.

maria.gomez: CHI: 24 cards total (6 nodes x 4 cards). MNL: 12 cards (3 nodes x 4 cards). We'll keep a 10% safety buffer for health probes and warmups.

liz.product: Pricing/commit guidance? Should sales link customers to Dedicated or prescribe burst?

maria.gomez: For now: recommend Dedicated reservation for production SLAs. Burst is best for experimentation and onboarding. Pricing note: A100z rate is +12% over our standard A100 public SKU due to quantization-friendly infra. We'll publish a short FAQ in Console under Reserved Pools -> CHI/MNL.

kyle-ops: Any special networking or KMS caveats for Private vs Hosted?

maria.gomez: No differences in networking. For Private deployments we don't offer these micro-pools (private = customer-managed infra). KMS/HSM flows unchanged.

samir.patel: How will routing choose between these pools and existing cohorts?

maria.gomez: Smart routing will prefer region affinity + lowest-latency pool. Customers can pin by region or pool tag: `pool:micro` or `gpu:nv-a100z`. Fallback policy: if micro pool is saturated, route to compatible family (nv-a100 / nv-a100q).

liz.product: Migration / upgrade notes for teams on older A100 profiles?

maria.gomez: Workloads should be compatible, but quantization differences mean you should run short-run evals. We recommend testing with the console eval harness and enabling prefix-KV caching to retain latency SLOs.

maria.gomez: CLI to reserve (example):
```
# reserve a monthly block in CHI
redwoodctl reserve create --region us-midwest-1 --pool micro --gpu nv-a100z --count 4 --term monthly
```

maria.gomez: Console path: Dedicated -> Reserve Capacity -> Select Region (us-midwest-1 / asia-southeast-3) -> Pool: micro -> GPU: A100z

oncall-jordan: Ops note — health probes will run every 90s; if a node fails we have automated fallback to standard pools. Will monitor first 48 hours.

ops-bot: [automated] New pool objects registered: pool-id=mp-ch1-206789, pool-id=mp-mnl-206790. Audit logs will appear under /ops/pools.

kyle-ops: Excellent. Can we get a short blurb for the docs team and the console banner?

maria.gomez: Yup — sending doc draft to #docs in 30m. Posting public-facing note tomorrow 09:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
